description: The main window only: the app's own commands for desktop features in every build (file dialogs for progress export and import, web links in the system browser, the maps library and its folder dialogs, deleting maps and their downloaded images, importing from a web page (and moving the page window, kept for a go, to the go's next page on the same site, and running the importer's style reader once in the page just read), keeping the style sheets of a game read from a wiki's pages in its folder and listing them, reading the activity log and recording how an import ended, exporting and importing pack files, and game saves: finding the saves folder, choosing a saves folder or file, listing and reading saves (read-only, only where the person chose), following new saves and recording how a save was used; and the game's own files: choosing the game's folder, listing the map files in its bundles and reading them, read-only, and recording counts of what was read; and on Android copying a picked pack file into the app first; and the person's own lists of a game: reading, writing and deleting their file beside the game's folder in the maps folder, and exporting and importing one list through the file dialogs; and games made in the app: choosing a picture, making a game, a map or a level from it, following and stopping that, renaming a game and deleting one of its maps; and the person's own locations, types and areas of a game: reading, writing and deleting their file beside the game's folder in the maps folder; and the person's own guide pages and changes to the guide pages of a game: reading, writing and deleting their file beside the game's folder in the maps folder; and the person's own notes on the locations of a game: reading, writing and deleting their file beside the game's folder in the maps folder; and the person's links between guide pages and the map of a game: reading, writing and deleting their file beside the game's folder in the maps folder; and the games the person shows under one title: reading and writing their one file in the maps folder; and the person's own photos of a game: choosing a picture, and reading, writing, listing and deleting the photos in their folder beside the game's folder in the maps folder; and pack files opened from the file manager: taking what opening them came to, and taking one off the list of pack files opened; and, in an app without downloads, the old folder maps and wikis of the maps folder it no longer uses: listing them, measuring one and removing those the person confirmed, which the other apps refuse). The commands for downloading map images and for viewing a map page and saving its images are granted in downloads/main-downloads.json, which only a build with downloads reads. The only plugin commands granted are listening to the shell's events and stopping that (core:event:allow-listen and allow-unlisten), so that the Library hears of pack files that arrived, changed or went and of a pack file opened; the web app cannot send events. The dialog, opener, single instance and (on Android) fs plugins are only used from Rust. No other window, and no remote page, is granted anything.
